questions.prompt: Who led the first successful expedition to the North Pole region by airship?
questions.fact: Whether earlier claims to have reached the pole on foot were genuine is still argued over.

questions.prompt: What is the term for the process by which cells divide to make identical copies?
questions.fact: Roughly two trillion of these divisions happen in an adult human body every day.

questions.prompt: Which country won the men's football World Cup in 2018?
questions.fact: It was their second title, twenty years after the first, which they also won as hosts.

questions.prompt: Which television series features a character called Sherlock Holmes played by Benedict Cumberbatch?
questions.fact: Its habit of putting text messages on screen was widely copied by other dramas afterwards.

questions.prompt: Which is the world's largest bay by area?
questions.fact: It is fed by the Ganges and Brahmaputra, which together carry more sediment than any other river system.

questions.prompt: Who wrote the play Waiting for Godot's contemporary, The Birthday Party?
questions.fact: It closed after eight performances following brutal reviews, and is now a standard set text.

questions.prompt: What does the acronym VoIP describe?
questions.fact: It undercut international call charges so completely that traditional long-distance pricing effectively disappeared.
